# Kudozz Club

> Kudozz Club is an India-focused travel agency that plans customized trips across India. Travellers share where they want to go, their dates, budget and travel style through the Plan My Trip form, and the Kudozz Club team plans the itinerary in-house and refines it with them by email. Pricing is quoted per enquiry; no package prices are published. The agency is backed by a library of 582 free destination guides covering all 28 Indian states and 8 union territories, which supplies the destination knowledge behind every itinerary.

Official website: https://club.kudozz.in (also searched as "Kudoz Club", "Kudos Club"). Contact: connect@kudozz.in.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://club.kudozz.in/): Kudozz Club, India travel agency for customized trips.
- [Plan My Trip](https://club.kudozz.in/plan-your-trip): trip enquiry form (destination, dates, travellers, trip type, budget, accommodation, contact details). The main way to start planning.
- [India Tour Packages](https://club.kudozz.in/packages): index of every destination, circuit and travel-style package page.
- [Destinations](https://club.kudozz.in/destinations): every destination guide, organised by state.
- [Travel Guides](https://club.kudozz.in/blog): the full guide library.
- [Adventure Travel in India](https://club.kudozz.in/adventure-travel): hub for adventure activities, destinations, seasons and planning guides.
- [Beach Travel in India](https://club.kudozz.in/beach-travel): hub for beach destinations, state-by-state beach guides, beach activities, seasons and safety.
- [Wildlife Tourism in India](https://club.kudozz.in/wildlife-tourism): hub for national parks, tiger reserves, sanctuaries, safaris, species, birdwatching, state wildlife guides and responsible travel.
- [Spiritual Tourism in India](https://club.kudozz.in/spiritual-tourism): hub for pilgrimage places of every faith, the Jyotirlingas, Char Dham, Shakti Peethas, Buddhist Circuit, Sikh and Jain pilgrimage, Sufi shrines, state spiritual guides, festivals and retreats.
- [Heritage & Cultural Tourism in India](https://club.kudozz.in/heritage-cultural-tourism): hub for UNESCO sites, monuments, forts, palaces, caves, archaeological sites, historic cities, museums, crafts, textiles, dance and music, festivals, food heritage, state heritage guides and itineraries.
- [About](https://club.kudozz.in/about): who Kudozz Club is, how trip planning works, editorial independence.
- [Contact](https://club.kudozz.in/contact): trip enquiries and other contact.

## How the site is organised

Content follows a geographic hierarchy and a planning funnel:

India → Region → State/Union Territory → City/Area → Attraction
Travel guide (informational) → Destination/state guide → Tour package page (commercial) → Plan My Trip (enquiry)

Each state/UT has one hub guide (marked 🗺️ below) linking to its city and attraction guides, and one tour package page at /packages/<state> linking back to those guides. Every guide links forward to its state's package page and to Plan My Trip. The guides stay independent: Kudozz Club does not accept paid placements in guide content.

An Adventure Travel cluster, with its hub at /adventure-travel, covers adventure activities (such as river rafting, paragliding, scuba diving, skiing and trekking), destination adventure hubs (such as /blog/adventure-activities-in-ladakh), weekend trips from major cities and planning guides. Each article gives seasons, difficulty, safety guidance and FAQs, and links on to the relevant destination guide, things-to-do article, itinerary, tour package and Plan My Trip. Seasonal closures (for example, Rishikesh rafting in the peak monsoon and the Bir Billing paragliding ban from 15 July to 15 September) are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Beach Travel cluster, with its hub at /beach-travel, has one beach guide per coastal state or island group (/blog/best-beaches-in-<state>), overview guides (best beach destinations, best beaches, beach holidays, beach trips from cities, beach tourism and coastal tourism), and guides to dolphin watching, beach honeymoons, offbeat beaches, seasons and beach safety. Water activities (diving, snorkelling, surfing, kayaking, water sports) are covered in the Adventure Travel cluster and linked from the beach pages. Swimming rules, monsoon bans and Blue Flag status are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Wildlife Tourism cluster, with its hub at /wildlife-tourism, has overview guides (best wildlife destinations, national parks, sanctuaries and safaris), tiger guides (tiger safari, best tiger reserves, planning a tiger safari, and Pench, Satpura and Sariska), species guides (where to see wildlife, leopards, rhinos and snow leopards), birdwatching, one guide per major wildlife state (/blog/wildlife-tourism-in-<state>), and planning guides on seasons, packing, photography and responsible tourism. Existing destination guides (such as Ranthambore, Jim Corbett, Kanha, Kaziranga and Gir) remain the main page for each park. Park seasons, closures and figures such as tiger and lion counts are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Spiritual Tourism cluster, with its hub at /spiritual-tourism, covers pilgrimage places and famous temples, the twelve Jyotirlingas (with the four Jyotirlinga temples that had no guide), the Char Dham Yatra of Uttarakhand and the separate four dhams of India, the Shakti Peethas, the Buddhist Circuit, Sikh pilgrimage and the Panj Takht, Jain tirthas, Sufi shrines, one guide per major spiritual state (/blog/spiritual-tourism-in-<state>), festivals and the Kumbh Mela, planning, and yoga retreats. Existing destination guides (such as Varanasi, Tirupati, Somnath and the Golden Temple) remain the main page for each sacred place. Where traditions differ on lists (Jyotirlingas, Shakti Peethas), the pages name the variations; dates, registrations and closures are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

A Heritage & Cultural Tourism cluster, with its hub at /heritage-cultural-tourism, covers historical places and the full list of India's 45 UNESCO World Heritage Sites (as of September 2026, including the Maratha Military Landscapes in 2025 and Sarnath in 2026), visitor guides to major monuments that had no page of their own (such as the Taj Mahal, Red Fort, Qutub Minar, Humayun's Tomb, Amber Fort, Mehrangarh and the Elephanta Caves), forts, palaces, archaeological sites and rock-cut caves, temple, Mughal, Deccan and colonial-era architecture, heritage cities and walks, museums, crafts, textiles, dance and music, cultural festivals, tribal tourism, food heritage and the mountain railways, one guide per major heritage state (/blog/heritage-tourism-in-<state>) and five itineraries. Existing destination guides (such as Agra, Jaipur, Hampi and Khajuraho) remain the main page for each place. Where archaeologists or historians disagree, the pages say so; timings, closures and festival dates are stated as current at the time of writing and should be checked before travel.

For 143 major destinations, a "Things to do in <place>" article (/blog/things-to-do-in-<place>) sits beside the destination guide. It focuses on activities and experiences, grouped by type, with practical facts, suitability notes and FAQs, and links back to the guide for planning details.

## Destination guides

## North India

### Delhi

- 🗺️ [Delhi Travel Guide: Red Fort, Qutub Minar & 3-Day Itinerary](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/delhi-travel-guide): Mughal forts, Sultanate-era minarets, colonial avenues, and one of the world's great street food scenes — the complete guide to India's layered capital.
- [Akshardham Temple Delhi: Timings, Tickets & Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/akshardham-delhi-travel-guide): Timings, ticket pricing, the Sahaj Anand Water Show, the boat ride, strict entry rules, and a full half-day plan for visiting Akshardham in Delhi.
- [Chanakyapuri Guide: Delhi's Diplomatic Enclave](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chanakyapuri-delhi-travel-guide): An honest look at Chanakyapuri — Delhi's diplomatic enclave of embassies, Nehru Park, tree-lined boulevards, and nearby Gandhi Smriti and Teen Murti Bhavan.
- [Chandni Chowk: Delhi's Legendary Food Walk & Bazaar Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chandni-chowk-delhi-travel-guide): A 350-year-old market built by Jahanara Begum — Kinari Bazaar, Khari Baoli's spice trade, and the legendary Chandni Chowk street food walk.
- [Connaught Place Guide: Shopping, Food & Nightlife](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/connaught-place-delhi-travel-guide): The Inner, Middle & Outer Circle layout, Central Park, Palika Bazaar, old-school eateries and nightlife — the complete guide to Delhi's Georgian-era commercial hub.
- [Dwarka, Delhi Travel Guide: Sub-City & ISKCON Temple](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/dwarka-delhi-travel-guide): One of Asia's largest planned sub-cities, minutes from IGI Airport — Dwarka's ISKCON Temple, sector markets, and metro access. Not Dwarka, Gujarat.
- [Hauz Khas Travel Guide: Village, Deer Park & Fort Ruins](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/hauz-khas-delhi-travel-guide): A 700-year-old royal reservoir and madrasa ruins sit right beside Delhi's trendiest boutique-and-nightlife village — the complete Hauz Khas guide.
- [Janakpuri Delhi Guide: Parks, Markets & Transport](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/janakpuri-delhi-travel-guide): A practical guide to Janakpuri, West Delhi's planned residential colony — District Park, local markets, the Janakpuri West Metro interchange, and why it's worth knowing about.
- [Karol Bagh Travel Guide: Shopping, Markets & Budget Hotels](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/karol-bagh-delhi-travel-guide): A pedestrianised bazaar on Ajmal Khan Road, Gaffar Market's electronics stalls, and one of Delhi's densest budget-hotel clusters — the complete guide to shopping, eating, and staying in Karol Bagh.
- [Kashmere Gate Travel Guide: History, 1857 Sites & the ISBT Hub](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kashmere-gate-delhi-travel-guide): Shahjahanabad's northern gate, an 1857 Revolt battleground, St. James' Church, Nicholson Cemetery, and Delhi's biggest ISBT transit hub — with a suggested heritage-walk plan.
- [Lajpat Nagar Travel Guide: Central Market & More](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/lajpat-nagar-delhi-travel-guide): One of Delhi's most beloved shopping neighbourhoods — Central Market's ethnic wear and bridal shopping, the Tibetan Market next door, bargaining etiquette, and a practical half-day plan.
- [Laxmi Nagar, Delhi: Market, Coaching Hub & Local Food Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/laxmi-nagar-delhi-travel-guide): A local's guide to Laxmi Nagar, Delhi — East Delhi's dense market-and-coaching neighbourhood, its UPSC/SSC institute ecosystem, PG accommodation, street food, and how to reach it by metro.
- [Lodhi Garden: Delhi's Tombs, Timings & Complete Visit Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/lodhi-garden-delhi-travel-guide): 90 acres of landscaped green in the middle of South Delhi, dotted with 500-year-old tombs from the Sayyid and Lodi dynasties — Delhi's favourite morning-walk park doubling as an open-air museum.
- [Majnu Ka Tilla Guide: Delhi's Tibetan Colony](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/majnu-ka-tilla-delhi-travel-guide): A slice of Tibet on the banks of the Yamuna — momos, thukpa, Korean cafés, prayer-flag markets, and Delhi's most concentrated Tibetan cultural enclave.
- [Mehrauli Travel Guide: Qutub Minar & Ancient Delhi](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mehrauli-delhi-travel-guide): Delhi's oldest continuously inhabited settlement — Qutub Minar, the rust-resistant Iron Pillar, a forest full of forgotten tombs, and 800+ years of layered history in one walkable quarter.
- [Najafgarh Delhi Guide: History, Jheel & Sehwag](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/najafgarh-delhi-travel-guide): An honest guide to Najafgarh — Nawab Najaf Khan's 18th-century fort roots, the shrinking Najafgarh Jheel wetland, and its fame as Virender Sehwag's hometown.
- [New Delhi Travel Guide: India Gate, Rajpath & More](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/new-delhi-travel-guide): Wide colonial avenues, a president's palace, and a parliament at the centre of the world's largest democracy — the complete guide to New Delhi's Lutyens-era core.
- [Nizamuddin Travel Guide: Dargah, Qawwali & Humayun's Tomb](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/nizamuddin-delhi-travel-guide): A 700-year-old Sufi shrine still alive with devotion, Thursday night qawwali, and Humayun's Tomb next door — inside Delhi's most spiritually alive neighbourhood.
- [Old Delhi Travel Guide: Red Fort, Jama Masjid & Food](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/old-delhi-travel-guide): Shahjahanabad, Shah Jahan's 17th-century walled capital — Red Fort, India's largest mosque, cycle-rickshaw lanes, havelis, bazaars, and a street food trail running for well over a century.
- [Paharganj Travel Guide: Main Bazaar & Budget Stays](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/paharganj-delhi-travel-guide): Delhi's classic backpacker district — Main Bazaar shopping, budget guesthouses, cheap eats, and honest safety tips, all right beside New Delhi Railway Station.
- [Rohini Delhi Guide: Japanese Park & Family Outings](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rohini-delhi-travel-guide): A practical Rohini guide — Delhi's huge DDA residential sub-city known for Japanese Park, Adventure Island, and extensive Metro coverage, not for heritage sightseeing.
- [Sarojini Nagar Market Guide: Shopping & Bargaining Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sarojini-nagar-delhi-travel-guide): A maze of stalls selling export-surplus clothing, footwear, and accessories at rock-bottom prices — how to shop Sarojini Nagar well and bargain like a local.
- [South Delhi Travel Guide: Best Areas & Things to Do](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/south-delhi-travel-guide): Hauz Khas, Greater Kailash, Saket, Vasant Kunj, Mehrauli, Lodhi Garden, and Chhatarpur Temple — a guide to Delhi's most affluent, green, and heritage-dense quarter, area by area.
- [Tughlaqabad Fort Travel Guide: Delhi's Cursed City](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/tughlaqabad-delhi-travel-guide): Delhi's massive, mostly-empty 14th-century fort ruins built by Sultan Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq — sloping ramparts, 13 gates, an underground citadel, and the legendary curse of Nizamuddin Auliya.
- [Vasant Kunj Guide: Malls, Shopping & Nature Nearby](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/vasant-kunj-delhi-travel-guide): Delhi's upscale mall district next to IGI Airport — Ambience Mall, DLF Promenade, DLF Emporio, and the surprisingly wild Asola Bhatti forest just beyond it.

### Chandigarh

- 🗺️ [Chandigarh Travel Guide: Rock Garden, Sukhna Lake & Itinerary](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chandigarh-travel-guide): Le Corbusier's modernist Capitol Complex, a rock garden built entirely from industrial waste, and a lake at the foot of the Shivaliks — the complete guide to India's most planned city.
- [Bougainvillea Garden Chandigarh: Blooms & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bougainvillea-garden-chandigarh-travel-guide): Trellised arches and pruned bougainvillea shrubs bursting into colour every summer — a quiet, mostly-local garden along the Leisure Valley.
- [Capitol Complex Chandigarh: Le Corbusier's UNESCO Site Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/capitol-complex-chandigarh-travel-guide): The High Court, Secretariat, and Assembly that anchor Le Corbusier's masterplan — a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the reason architects fly to Chandigarh.
- [Chandigarh Botanical Garden: Sarangpur Visit Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chandigarh-botanical-garden-travel-guide): A sprawling, research-driven botanical garden on the city's outskirts — Chandigarh's most off-beat green escape, far removed from the manicured city gardens.
- [Garden of Fragrance Chandigarh: Scented Plants & Braille Trail](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/garden-of-fragrance-chandigarh-travel-guide): A small garden built around scent rather than sight, with Braille signage for visually impaired visitors — one of Chandigarh's most thoughtful lesser-known gardens.
- [Government Museum Chandigarh: Gandhara Art & Miniatures](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/government-museum-chandigarh-travel-guide): Gandhara-era stone sculpture and Pahari miniature paintings in a quiet Sector 10 museum most tourists walk straight past.
- [International Dolls Museum Chandigarh: Visit Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/international-dolls-museum-chandigarh-travel-guide): Dolls from dozens of countries in traditional costume, tucked inside the Bal Bhavan complex — Chandigarh's quirkiest, most kid-friendly museum stop.
- [Japanese Garden Chandigarh: Pagodas, Ponds & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/japanese-garden-chandigarh-travel-guide): Arched bridges, pagoda pavilions, and a still pond — Chandigarh's quietest themed garden, built around Japanese design principles.
- [Le Corbusier Centre Chandigarh: Museum Visit Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/le-corbusier-centre-chandigarh-travel-guide): Original drawings, models, and photographs documenting how Le Corbusier planned an entire city from scratch — the essential primer before visiting the Capitol Complex.
- [Leisure Valley Chandigarh: The City's Green Corridor Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/leisure-valley-chandigarh-travel-guide): A continuous green spine linking the Rose Garden, Bougainvillea Garden, and more — here's how to walk or cycle Chandigarh's Leisure Valley end to end.
- [Rock Garden Chandigarh: Nek Chand's Sculpture Garden Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rock-garden-chandigarh-travel-guide): Thousands of mosaic sculptures built secretly from industrial waste and broken bangles — Nek Chand's Rock Garden is Chandigarh's strangest, most beloved attraction.
- [Sector 17 Chandigarh: Plaza, Shopping & Nightlife Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sector-17-chandigarh-travel-guide): Chandigarh's pedestrian-only city centre — fountains, cafés, Neelam Cinema, and the plaza every evening in the city eventually passes through.
- [Sector 22 Chandigarh: Market, Stays & Local Life Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sector-22-chandigarh-travel-guide): A working residential sector with a busy everyday market — Sector 22 is where budget stays and ordinary Chandigarh life meet.
- [Sector 26 Chandigarh: Grain Market Food Street Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sector-26-chandigarh-travel-guide): Chandigarh's best-known late-night food street sits beside its wholesale grain and vegetable mandi — butter chicken, tikkas, and kulchas till late.
- [Sector 35 Chandigarh: Market, Cafés & Student Vibe Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sector-35-chandigarh-travel-guide): SCO markets, casual cafés, and a younger crowd — Sector 35 is Chandigarh's most contemporary commercial strip.
- [Shanti Kunj Chandigarh: A Quiet Garden Near Rose Garden](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/shanti-kunj-chandigarh-travel-guide): A small, low-key green pocket near the Rose Garden — Chandigarh's simplest stop for a peaceful walk away from the crowds.
- [Sukhna Lake Chandigarh: Promenade, Boating & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sukhna-lake-chandigarh-travel-guide): A man-made lake at the foot of the Shivalik hills, ringed by a 3-km promenade — Sukhna Lake is Chandigarh's favourite sunrise and sunset spot.
- [Terraced Garden Chandigarh: Sector 33 Visit Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/terraced-garden-chandigarh-travel-guide): Stepped lawns and seasonal flowerbeds across multiple levels — a quieter picnic and photography alternative to the Rose Garden.
- [Zakir Hussain Rose Garden: Chandigarh's Rose Festival Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rose-garden-chandigarh-travel-guide): Asia's largest rose garden — 30 acres and over 1,600 rose varieties in full bloom every February, right in the heart of Sector 16.

### Punjab

- 🗺️ [Punjab Travel Guide: Golden Temple, Amritsar & Wagah Border](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/punjab-travel-guide): A temple that shimmers gold over a sacred pool, a nightly border ceremony full of pageantry, and food that shaped how the rest of India eats — the complete guide to Punjab.

- [Bathinda Travel Guide: Qila Mubarak & History](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bathinda-travel-guide): An ancient fort linked to Razia Sultana, the only woman to rule the Delhi Sultanate — the honest guide to one of Punjab's oldest, least-touristed cities.

- [Golden Temple Guide: Timings, Langar & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/golden-temple-travel-guide): Sikhism's holiest shrine, a free kitchen feeding tens of thousands daily regardless of faith, and a sarovar that gives Amritsar its name — the complete Golden Temple guide.

- [Mohali Travel Guide: Cricket, Stay & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mohali-travel-guide): Chandigarh's modern satellite city, home to one of India's biggest cricket stadiums and a genuinely comfortable base for exploring the tricity area.
- [Patiala Travel Guide: Qila Mubarak & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/patiala-travel-guide): A royal fort that gave India two lasting cultural exports — the Patiala peg and the Patiala salwar — the complete guide to Punjab's former princely capital.
- [Ranjit Sagar Dam Guide: Best Time & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/ranjit-sagar-dam-travel-guide): A hill-backed reservoir on the Ravi river near the Punjab-J&K border — one of the state's quietest, most scenic departures from its flat agricultural plains.
- [Sultanpur Lodhi Guide: Guru Nanak's Sacred Town](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sultanpur-lodhi-travel-guide): The rivulet where Guru Nanak is believed to have found spiritual enlightenment, and a restored waterway with a genuine conservation story — the complete Sultanpur Lodhi guide.

- [Wagah Border Guide: Beating Retreat Ceremony](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/wagah-border-travel-guide): High-kicking marches, roaring crowds on both sides of a closed border, and a nightly flag-lowering ceremony unlike anything else in the world — the complete Wagah Border guide.

- [Khardung La Travel Guide: Height, Route, Permits & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/khardung-la-travel-guide): At 5,359 metres, the air thins, prayer flags snap in the wind, and the road to Nubra Valley climbs above the clouds — everything you need to cross Khardung La safely and unforgettably.
- [Lamayuru Travel Guide: Moonland, Monastery & How to Visit](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/lamayuru-travel-guide): Ladakh's oldest monastery perches above a landscape so eroded it's simply called the Moonland — here's how to see it right, from the Yuru Kabgyat festival to the short treks that begin at its gates.
- [Leh Travel Guide: Leh Palace, Market, Shanti Stupa & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/leh-travel-guide): A whitewashed old town under a ruined nine-storey palace, at 3,524 metres — Leh Palace, the bazaar, Shanti Stupa, and everything you need to explore the capital of Ladakh itself.
- [Nubra Valley Travel Guide: Sand Dunes, Camels & Cold Desert](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/nubra-valley-travel-guide): Cross the world's second-highest motorable pass into a valley where sand dunes meet snow peaks, Bactrian camels roam ancient Silk Route trails, and a 32-metre Buddha watches over the Shyok River.
- [Padum Travel Guide: Zanskar Valley's Historic Capital Town](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/padum-travel-guide): A dusty bazaar town where two rivers meet, Padum is Zanskar's historic capital and the essential base for its monasteries, royal ruins, and legendary high-altitude treks.
- [Pangong Lake Travel Guide: Routes, Permits, Camping & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/pangong-lake-travel-guide): A saline lake at 4,225 metres that turns turquoise to violet across a single afternoon — here's how to reach it, camp on its shore, and see it away from the crowds.
- [Thiksey Travel Guide: Monastery, Morning Prayers & Maitreya Buddha](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/thiksey-travel-guide): Twelve storeys of whitewashed walls climb a hillside above the Indus like a mini Potala Palace — home to a 15-metre golden Buddha and the most spellbinding 6 AM prayer ceremony in Ladakh.
- [Tso Moriri Travel Guide: Ladakh's Most Pristine High-Altitude Lake](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/tso-moriri-travel-guide): A sapphire lake at 4,522 metres on the remote Rupshu plateau, ringed by bare mountains and grazed by wild kiang — Tso Moriri is the Ladakh lake that stayed wild.
- [Turtuk Travel Guide: Ladakh's Last Balti Village Before the LOC](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/turtuk-travel-guide): A Balti village of stone houses and apricot orchards on the Shyok River, under Pakistani control until 1971 and closed to outsiders until 2010 — Turtuk is unlike anywhere else in Ladakh.
- [Zanskar Valley Travel Guide: Chadar Trek, Phugtal Monastery & Padum](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/zanskar-valley-travel-guide): Cut off from the world for eight months a year by snow, Zanskar is Ladakh's last true frontier — home to the legendary frozen-river Chadar Trek and the cliffside Phugtal Monastery.

- [Kannauj Travel Guide: India's Perfume Capital](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kannauj-travel-guide): Known as Ittar Nagri — the deg-bhapka attar tradition, working perfume workshops, and Kannauj's deep history as Harsha's 7th-century capital.

- [Naimisharanya Travel Guide: Sacred Forest & Temples](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/naimisharanya-travel-guide): An ancient sacred forest of the Puranas — Chakra Tirtha, the Lalita Devi Shakti Peeth, and a genuinely off-the-beaten-path pilgrimage near Lucknow.
- [Pilibhit Tiger Reserve: Safari & Visit Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/pilibhit-travel-guide): Dense terai forest along the Sharda river, one of India's higher tiger densities relative to area, and a quiet, largely undiscovered reserve.
- [Prayagraj Travel Guide: Triveni Sangam & Kumbh Mela](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/prayagraj-travel-guide): The sacred Ganga-Yamuna-Saraswati confluence, home to the Kumbh Mela — plus Allahabad Fort, Anand Bhavan, and Khusro Bagh.

### Rajasthan

- 🗺️ [Rajasthan Travel Guide: Jaipur, Jodhpur & Pushkar Circuit](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rajasthan-travel-guide): Pink-walled bazaars, a fort city painted entirely blue, and royal palaces still standing where maharajas built them centuries ago — the complete guide to Rajasthan's classic circuit.
- [Abhaneri Guide: Chand Baori Stepwell & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/abhaneri-travel-guide): Thirteen stories of symmetrical zigzagging steps descend into the earth — one of the world's largest and deepest stepwells, hiding in a small Rajasthan village.
- [Ajmer Travel Guide: Dargah Sharif & Ana Sagar](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/ajmer-travel-guide): One of India's most important Sufi shrines, a 12th-century lake, and a mosque built from a repurposed Sanskrit college — the complete Ajmer guide.

- [Bundi Travel Guide: Stepwells, Palace & Murals](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bundi-travel-guide): A palace Kipling called finer than a dream, more ornate stepwells than anywhere else in Rajasthan, and a fraction of Jodhpur's crowds — the complete Bundi guide.

- [Jaipur Travel Guide: Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/jaipur-travel-guide): A pink-washed old city, a hilltop fort reached by elephant, and a honeycombed palace built so royal women could watch the streets unseen — the complete Jaipur guide.
- [Jaisalmer & Thar Desert Travel Guide: Fort, Camel Safari & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rajasthan-desert-travel-guide): A living medieval fort rising from the Thar Desert, camel safaris into the dunes and the most spectacular havelis in Rajasthan — the complete guide to Jaisalmer.
- [Jawai Travel Guide: Leopard Hills & Rabari Villages](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/jawai-travel-guide): Granite hills where wild leopards roam within sight of shepherd villages — one of India's most distinctive, least conflict-driven wildlife stories.
- [Jodhpur Travel Guide: Mehrangarh Fort & Blue City](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/jodhpur-travel-guide): One of India's largest, best-preserved forts rises over a sea of indigo-washed houses — the complete guide to Jodhpur, the Blue City of Marwar.
- [Khatu Shyam Ji Guide: Temple & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/khatu-shyam-ji-travel-guide): A legend of ultimate sacrifice, waves of devotional song, and one of Rajasthan's most intensely visited pilgrimage towns — the complete Khatu Shyam Ji guide.
- [Kumbhalgarh Fort Guide: The Great Wall of India](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kumbhalgarh-travel-guide): A 36-km fortified wall across the Aravalli hills, the birthplace of Maharana Pratap, and a wildlife sanctuary at its feet — the complete Kumbhalgarh guide.
- [Mandawa Travel Guide: Shekhawati Havelis & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mandawa-travel-guide): A desert town where merchant fortunes were painted onto every wall — the complete guide to Mandawa's frescoed havelis and Shekhawati's open-air art tradition.
- [Mount Abu Travel Guide: Dilwara Temples & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mount-abu-travel-guide): Rajasthan's only hill station, home to marble-carved Jain temples of extraordinary intricacy — the complete Mount Abu guide.
- [Osian Travel Guide: Desert Temples & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/osian-travel-guide): Ancient Hindu and Jain temples rise straight out of the Thar Desert near Jodhpur — the complete guide to Osian's 8th-12th century heritage and quieter dunes.
- [Pushkar Travel Guide: Lake, Temple & Camel Fair](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/pushkar-travel-guide): A sacred lake ringed by 52 ghats, one of the world's only Brahma temples, and a camel fair that turns the desert into a festival — the complete Pushkar guide.
- [Ranthambore Safari Guide: Tigers & Fort](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/ranthambore-travel-guide): Tigers photographed against the ramparts of a 10th-century fort — one of India's most iconic, and most photogenic, tiger reserves.

## West India

### Gujarat

- 🗺️ [Gujarat Travel Guide: Rann of Kutch, Somnath & Gir National Park](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/gujarat-travel-guide): A shimmering white salt desert stretching to the horizon, temple towns steeped in mythology, and the last wild lions outside Africa — Gujarat is India's most quietly extraordinary state.
- [Ahmedabad Travel Guide: Heritage Walk, Sabarmati Ashram & Food](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/ahmedabad-travel-guide): India's first UNESCO World Heritage City, home to Gandhi's ashram on the Sabarmati riverbank and a street-food scene that runs half the night — the complete guide to Ahmedabad.
- [Dholavira Travel Guide: Harappan City & UNESCO World Heritage Site](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/dholavira-travel-guide): A 5,000-year-old Indus Valley Civilization city with a water conservation system centuries ahead of its time, on a remote island in the Rann of Kutch — the complete guide to Dholavira.
- [Gir National Park Travel Guide: Asiatic Lion Safari & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/gir-national-park-travel-guide): The last place on Earth with wild Asiatic lions outside Africa, and one of India's most successful conservation stories — the complete guide to Gir National Park.
- [Junagadh & Girnar Travel Guide: 10,000 Steps to Jain & Hindu Shrines](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/junagadh-girnar-travel-guide): A hilltop pilgrimage of nearly 10,000 stone steps leading to Jain temples and a Hindu shrine at the summit, above a 2,000-year-old fort city — the complete guide to Junagadh and Girnar.
- [Mandvi Travel Guide: Beach, Shipbuilding Yards & Vijay Vilas Palace](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mandvi-travel-guide): A Kutch coastal town where wooden cargo ships are still built by hand on the beach, beside a Rajasthani-style seaside palace — the complete guide to Mandvi.
- [Palitana Travel Guide: 3,500 Steps to the World's Largest Jain Temple Complex](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/palitana-travel-guide): Over 900 marble temples clustered on a single hilltop, reached by a climb of more than 3,500 steps — the complete guide to Palitana.
- [Patan Travel Guide: Rani ki Vav Stepwell & Patola Sarees](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/patan-travel-guide): A seven-storey inverted temple carved entirely underground, and a handwoven silk saree so intricate it takes months to make — the complete guide to Patan.
- [Polo Forest Travel Guide: Ruined Temples in the Aravalli Jungle](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/polo-forest-travel-guide): 15th-century temple ruins swallowed by dense Aravalli forest, one of Gujarat's most genuinely off-the-radar destinations — the complete guide to Polo Forest.
- [Rann of Kutch Travel Guide: White Desert & Rann Utsav](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rann-of-kutch-travel-guide): A salt desert that turns silver-white under a full moon, and a month-long cultural festival that transforms it into a tent city every winter — the complete guide to the Rann of Kutch.
- [Saputara Travel Guide: Gujarat's Only Hill Station](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/saputara-travel-guide): A lake-centred hill station in the Sahyadri range, the one place in Gujarat that actually feels like a monsoon retreat — the complete guide to Saputara.
- [Somnath Temple Travel Guide: History, Timings & Light Show](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/somnath-travel-guide): The first of the 12 Jyotirlingas, destroyed and rebuilt multiple times over a thousand years, standing today rebuilt in Chalukya style facing the Arabian Sea — the complete guide to Somnath.
- [Statue of Unity Travel Guide: World's Tallest Statue, Timings & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/statue-of-unity-travel-guide): The world's tallest statue, twice the height of the Statue of Liberty, rising from an island in the Narmada River — the complete guide to the Statue of Unity.
- [Surat Travel Guide: Diamond City, Riverfront & Street Food](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/surat-travel-guide): A city that cuts and polishes most of the world's diamonds, with a revamped Tapi riverfront and a street food culture to match Ahmedabad's — the complete guide to Surat.
- [Vadodara Travel Guide: Laxmi Vilas Palace & Baroda's Heritage](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/vadodara-travel-guide): A palace four times the size of Buckingham Palace, still home to the Gaekwad royal family — the complete guide to Vadodara.
- [Dwarka Travel Guide: Krishna's Ancient Kingdom & Char Dham Site](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/dwarka-travel-guide): One of Hinduism's four Char Dham pilgrimage sites, believed to be the ancient capital of Krishna's kingdom on the Arabian Sea coast — the complete guide to Dwarka.

### Maharashtra

- 🗺️ [Maharashtra Travel Guide: Mumbai, Ajanta-Ellora & Konkan Coast](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/maharashtra-travel-guide): A city that never sleeps, 2,000-year-old rock-cut cave temples, and a coastline dotted with sea forts and fishing villages — the complete guide to Maharashtra.

- [Lonavala Travel Guide: Waterfalls, Caves & Monsoon Getaway](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/lonavala-travel-guide): Mist-wrapped ghats two hours from Mumbai and Pune, 2,000-year-old rock-cut caves, and waterfalls that roar to life every monsoon — the complete guide to Lonavala.
- [Mahabaleshwar Travel Guide: Viewpoints, Strawberries & Itinerary](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mahabaleshwar-travel-guide): Table-top viewpoints over the Western Ghats, strawberry farms lining every road, and the source of the Krishna River — the complete guide to Maharashtra's favourite hill station.
- [Matheran Travel Guide: India's Only Vehicle-Free Hill Station](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/matheran-travel-guide): No cars, no bikes, not even bicycles allowed — just red mud trails, a century-old toy train, and panoramic points over the Sahyadris. The complete guide to Matheran.
- [Mumbai Travel Guide: Gateway of India, Marine Drive & Bollywood](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mumbai-travel-guide): Colonial-era monuments beside the Arabian Sea, a promenade lit up every evening as the Queen's Necklace, and the beating heart of Indian cinema — the complete guide to Mumbai.
- [Nashik Travel Guide: Vineyards, Temples & Godavari Ghats](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/nashik-travel-guide): India's wine capital, a riverside pilgrimage town on the Godavari, and the vineyards drawing weekend crowds from Mumbai and Pune — the complete guide to Nashik.

- [Shirdi Travel Guide: Sai Baba Temple, Timings & How to Reach](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/shirdi-travel-guide): One of India's most-visited pilgrimage towns, built around the shrine of Sai Baba — the complete guide to darshan timings, stays, and getting to Shirdi.
- [Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve: Safari Guide, Zones & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/tadoba-travel-guide): Maharashtra's oldest and largest national park, with among the best tiger-sighting odds in Central India — the complete safari guide to Tadoba.
- [Tarkarli Travel Guide: Scuba Diving, Beaches & Malvan](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/tarkarli-travel-guide): Clear turquoise water rare on India's west coast, scuba diving over live coral, and Malvani seafood straight off the boat — the complete guide to Tarkarli.

### Goa

- [Palolem Beach Travel Guide: South Goa's Postcard Crescent](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/palolem-travel-guide): A curved, palm-backed South Goa beach that's kept its laid-back character far better than the North Goa strip — the complete guide to Palolem.
- [Panjim Travel Guide: Fontainhas, Latin Quarter & Goa's Capital](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/panjim-travel-guide): Pastel-colored Portuguese townhouses lining narrow lanes in Fontainhas, and a riverside capital that still moves at old-Goa pace — the complete guide to Panjim.
- [Ponda Travel Guide: Hindu Temples & Spice Plantation Tours](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/ponda-travel-guide): Goa's temple town, where deities relocated during Portuguese rule still stand, surrounded by spice plantations open for tours — the complete guide to Ponda.
- [Vagator Beach Travel Guide: Red Cliffs & Chapora Fort](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/vagator-travel-guide): Red laterite cliffs dropping into the Arabian Sea, beside the fort that made a cameo in every Goa road-trip photo since Dil Chahta Hai — the complete guide to Vagator.

### Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

- 🗺️ [Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu Travel Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/dadra-nagar-haveli-daman-diu-travel-guide): A 16th-century Portuguese sea fort, near-empty beaches, and duty-free shopping — the complete guide to India's smallest, most overlooked Union Territory.
- [Daman Travel Guide: Forts, Beaches & Weekend Trip](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/daman-travel-guide): A former Portuguese enclave split by the Daman Ganga river into Moti Daman and Nani Daman — forts, quiet beaches, duty-free shopping, and a full 2-day itinerary for this Gujarat coastal getaway.
- [Devka Beach Daman: Promenade, Rides & Activities](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/devka-beach-travel-guide): Daman's busiest, most developed beach — a landscaped seafront promenade, garden, rock-climbing wall, camel rides, and food stalls, with honest advice on the rocky shoreline and best evening visit plan.
- [Diu Fort Travel Guide: History, Timings & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/diu-fort-travel-guide): A 16th-century Portuguese sea fort with a seawater-filled moat, original cannons, and one of the best sunset spots on India's west coast — the complete guide to Diu Fort.
- [Diu Travel Guide: Beaches, Fort & Weekend Trip](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/diu-travel-guide): A former Portuguese colony off Gujarat's coast — Diu Fort, quiet beaches, old-town churches, duty-free liquor, and a full 2-day itinerary.
- [Dudhni Lake Travel Guide: Boating Near Silvassa](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/dudhni-travel-guide): A short drive from Silvassa, Dudhni is a quiet reservoir village on the Madhuban Dam backwaters — motorboat rides, picnic spots, and an easy half-day escape from town.
- [Gangeshwar Temple, Diu: A Shiva Shrine Washed by the Sea](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/gangeshwar-temple-travel-guide): Five natural rock lingams set among the boulders on Diu's southern coastline, partly covered by the tide — when to go, how to visit respectfully, and how to stay safe.
- [Ghoghla Beach Diu: Water Sports & Camping Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/ghoghla-beach-travel-guide): A long, wide beach where Diu island meets the Gujarat mainland — jet-skiing, banana boat rides, beach camping, and a quieter alternative to Nagoa.
- [Jampore Beach Daman: Camel Rides, Timings & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/jampore-beach-travel-guide): A long, quiet, casuarina-lined beach south of Moti Daman — camel and pony rides, sunset walks, and honest advice on swimming conditions.
- [Khanvel Travel Guide: Gardens & Nature Escape](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/khanvel-travel-guide): A small forested town near Silvassa with a family-friendly garden, and the gateway to Satmaliya Deer Sanctuary and Madhuban Dam.
- [Madhuban Dam Travel Guide: Reservoir, Viewpoint & Picnic Spot](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/madhuban-dam-travel-guide): A dam on the Damanganga river whose reservoir stretches to Dudhni's boat jetties — the dam viewpoint, forest and birdlife, and a half-day plan near Silvassa.
- [Moti Daman Fort: The Fort of St. Jerome, Bastion by Bastion](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/moti-daman-fort-travel-guide): A 16th-century Portuguese fortress so large it doesn't just guard a town — it contains one. Ten bastions, a gilded church, old cannons, and a district collectorate, all inside the same set of walls.
- [Moti Daman Travel Guide: Old Town, Churches & Fort](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/moti-daman-travel-guide): Massive fort walls, a gilded church altar, and the quiet lanes of old Portuguese administration — inside Moti Daman, the grander, southern half of Daman's historic riverside old town.
- [Nagoa Beach Diu: Water Sports, Timings & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/nagoa-beach-travel-guide): A horseshoe-shaped bay of calm water, coconut-lined promenade and Diu's only real watersports scene — everything you need for a half-day at Nagoa Beach.
- [Naida Caves Diu: Photography Spot & Visit Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/naida-caves-travel-guide): A maze of sun-dappled sandstone chambers near Diu Fort — natural skylights, root-covered walls, and one of Diu's best offbeat photography spots.
- [Nani Daman Travel Guide: Fort, Harbour & Lighthouse](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/nani-daman-travel-guide): The smaller, northern quarter of Daman town — a working fishing harbour, the Fort of St. Francis Xavier, and a lighthouse across the river from Moti Daman.
- [Satmaliya Deer Sanctuary: Visit Guide & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/satmaliya-deer-sanctuary-travel-guide): A small, quiet forest sanctuary near Khanvel where spotted deer roam close to the trees — how to reach it, what to expect, and how to pair it with Madhuban Dam.
- [Silvassa Travel Guide: Lakes, Forests & Tribal Culture](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/silvassa-travel-guide): Capital of Dadra & Nagar Haveli — Dudhni's lake and Tribal Museum, Khanvel's gardens, Satmaliya Deer Sanctuary, Madhuban Dam, Warli tribal art, and a full 2-day itinerary for this green, inland weekend escape near Mumbai.
- [Vanganga Lake Garden, Daman: Complete Visit Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/vanganga-lake-garden-travel-guide): A landscaped garden built around a lake, dotted with miniature replicas of famous world landmarks — one of Daman's most relaxed, easy-to-love family stops.

## South India

### Karnataka

- 🗺️ [Karnataka Travel Guide: Bangalore, Mysore & Hampi](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/karnataka-travel-guide): From Bangalore's tech-city energy to Mysore's royal palaces, the ancient ruins of Hampi, and coffee hills beyond — a complete guide to planning a multi-region trip across Karnataka.
- [Badami, Aihole & Pattadakal Travel Guide: Chalukya Cave Temples](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/badami-aihole-pattadakal-travel-guide): Rock-cut cave temples carved into a red sandstone cliff, and a UNESCO-listed cluster of Chalukyan temple experiments that shaped Indian architecture — the complete guide to the Badami-Aihole-Pattadakal circuit.
- [Bandipur National Park: Tiger Safari Guide, Zones & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bandipur-travel-guide): One of India's first Project Tiger reserves, straddling the highway between Karnataka and the Nilgiris — the complete safari guide to Bandipur.
- [Bengaluru Travel Guide: Gardens, Palaces & India's Tech Capital](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bengaluru-travel-guide): Cubbon Park's green spread in the middle of a tech-boom skyline, a Tipu Sultan summer palace, and the country's best-known startup scene — the complete guide to Bengaluru.
- [Chikmagalur Travel Guide: Coffee Estates, Peaks & Waterfalls](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chikmagalur-travel-guide): Karnataka's coffee country, ringed by the Western Ghats' highest peaks and waterfalls that turn into full-throated cascades every monsoon — the complete guide to Chikmagalur.
- [Coorg Travel Guide: Coffee, Waterfalls, Trekking & More](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/coorg-travel-guide): Misty coffee hills, thundering waterfalls, Nagarhole wildlife and Kodava warmth — South India's most quietly magnificent escape.
- [Dandeli Travel Guide: White-Water Rafting & Wildlife Sanctuary](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/dandeli-travel-guide): River rapids fed by a dam release, a wildlife sanctuary with black panthers and hornbills, and Karnataka's best-known adventure sports hub — the complete guide to Dandeli.
- [Gokarna Travel Guide: Best Beaches, Temples & Itinerary](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/gokarna-beaches-travel-guide): A temple town with world-class beaches — Om Beach, Half Moon, and Paradise — linked by a cliffside trek and still a fraction as commercial as Goa.
- [Hampi Travel Guide: Ruins, Boulders, Temples & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/hampi-travel-guide): The extraordinary ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire scattered across a surreal boulder landscape — the complete guide to Hampi.
- [Jog Falls Travel Guide: India's Tallest Plunge Waterfall](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/jog-falls-travel-guide): A four-pronged waterfall dropping nearly 830 feet in a single, undivided plunge — the complete guide to Jog Falls.
- [Kabini Travel Guide: Wildlife Safari & Backwater Boat Rides](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kabini-travel-guide): One of India's best spots for leopard sightings, plus boat safaris across a reservoir instead of the usual jeep-only format — the complete guide to Kabini.
- [Mangaluru Travel Guide: Beaches, Temples & Coastal Cuisine](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mangaluru-travel-guide): A port city where fiery Mangalorean seafood curries meet centuries-old temples and Arabian Sea beaches — the complete guide to Mangaluru.
- [Mysuru Travel Guide: Mysore Palace, Dasara & City Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mysuru-travel-guide): A Wodeyar-dynasty palace lit by nearly 100,000 bulbs every evening, and a ten-day Dasara festival that turns the whole city into a procession — the complete guide to Mysuru.
- [Nandi Hills Travel Guide: Sunrise Point Near Bengaluru](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/nandi-hills-travel-guide): A fortified hilltop just outside Bengaluru, famous for sunrise views above a sea of clouds — the complete guide to Nandi Hills.
- [Sakleshpur Travel Guide: Coffee Trails, Railway Trek & Waterfalls](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sakleshpur-travel-guide): A misty Western Ghats coffee town famous for an abandoned railway trek through tunnels and bridges — the complete guide to Sakleshpur.
- [Udupi Travel Guide: Krishna Temple, Beaches & Udupi Cuisine](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/udupi-travel-guide): The temple town that gave India its vegetarian restaurant chain culture, plus a quiet stretch of Karnataka coast — the complete guide to Udupi.

### Kerala

- 🗺️ [Kerala Backwaters Guide: Houseboats, Routes, Villages & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kerala-backwaters-travel-guide): A 900-km network of lagoons, canals and lakes explored by houseboat — the complete guide to Kerala's backwaters.
- [Alappuzha (Alleppey) Travel Guide: Houseboats & Backwaters](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/alappuzha-travel-guide): The 'Venice of the East' — a maze of palm-lined backwater canals best explored overnight on a converted rice barge — the complete guide to Alappuzha.
- [Athirappilly Falls Travel Guide: Kerala's Niagara & Best Time to Visit](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/athirappilly-travel-guide): Kerala's biggest waterfall, thundering 80 feet through rainforest just outside a tiger reserve — the complete guide to Athirappilly.
- [Bekal Travel Guide: Fort, Beach & North Kerala's Quiet Coast](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bekal-travel-guide): Kerala's largest fort rising straight out of the Arabian Sea, on a coastline that still sees a fraction of Kovalam's crowds — the complete guide to Bekal.
- [Gavi Travel Guide: Eco-Tourism, Forest Trails & Permits](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/gavi-travel-guide): A permit-only eco-tourism forest inside the Periyar Tiger Reserve buffer zone, with almost no crowds and some of Kerala's densest wildlife — the complete guide to Gavi.
- [Guruvayur Temple Travel Guide: Darshan, Timings & How to Reach](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/guruvayur-travel-guide): One of Kerala's most revered Krishna temples, home to a herd of temple elephants and a darshan queue that starts before sunrise — the complete guide to Guruvayur.
- [Kannur Travel Guide: Theyyam, Beaches & Handloom Heritage](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kannur-travel-guide): A ritual dance-form where performers are worshipped as living deities, near-empty beaches, and centuries-old handloom weaving villages — the complete guide to Kannur.
- [Kochi Travel Guide: Fort Kochi, Chinese Nets & 3-Day Itinerary](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kochi-travel-guide): Chinese fishing nets silhouetted against the sunset, spice-trade history layered under Portuguese and Dutch influence, and Kerala's most walkable old town — the complete guide to Kochi.
- [Kovalam Travel Guide: Lighthouse Beach, Ayurveda & Itinerary](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kovalam-travel-guide): Three crescent coves anchored by a working lighthouse, and one of South India's original beach destinations for Ayurvedic wellness — the complete guide to Kovalam.
- [Kumarakom Travel Guide: Vembanad Lake, Bird Sanctuary & Houseboats](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kumarakom-travel-guide): A quieter, greener answer to Alleppey's backwaters, with a bird sanctuary on Kerala's largest lake — the complete guide to Kumarakom.
- [Munnar Travel Guide: Tea Gardens, Viewpoints & Best Time to Visit](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/munnar-travel-guide): Rolling tea estates climbing into the clouds, a rare flower that blooms once every 12 years, and the coolest hill air in Kerala — the complete guide to Munnar.
- [Munroe Island Travel Guide: Backwater Canoeing & Village Life](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/munroe-island-travel-guide): A cluster of tiny islands where the Ashtamudi Lake meets the Kallada River, explored by narrow canoe through coir-village canals — the complete guide to Munroe Island.
- [Thekkady Travel Guide: Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary & Spice Plantations](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/thekkady-travel-guide): Boat safaris across a reservoir ringed by elephant herds, and spice plantations still growing the cardamom and pepper that built Kerala's ancient trade routes — the complete guide to Thekkady.
- [Vagamon Travel Guide: Meadows, Pine Forests & Paragliding](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/vagamon-travel-guide): Rolling grass meadows compared to Scotland, pine forests planted by a British-era estate, and Kerala's paragliding hub — the complete guide to Vagamon.
- [Varkala Travel Guide: Cliff Beach, Yoga & Best Time to Visit](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/varkala-travel-guide): A red laterite cliff running straight along the Arabian Sea, lined with cafes above the sand — one of Kerala's few beaches with a view like this — the complete guide to Varkala.
- [Wayanad Travel Guide: Waterfalls, Wildlife & Western Ghats](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/wayanad-travel-guide): Misty coffee and spice plantations, ancient caves with 6,000-year-old rock carvings, and a wildlife sanctuary linking three states — the complete guide to Wayanad.

### Tamil Nadu

- 🗺️ [Tamil Nadu Travel Guide: Madurai, Mahabalipuram & Ooty](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/tamil-nadu-travel-guide): Temple towers carved with thousands of painted deities, UNESCO shore temples on the Bay of Bengal, and tea gardens in the Nilgiri hills — the complete guide to Dravidian India.
- [Chennai Travel Guide: Beaches, Temples & Food](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chennai-travel-guide): One of the world's longest urban beaches, Dravidian temples tucked into old neighbourhoods, and a food scene built on filter coffee and dosas — the complete Chennai guide.
- [Chettinad Travel Guide: Mansions & Cuisine](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chettinad-travel-guide): Grand merchant mansions built with imported marble and teak, and one of India's boldest regional cuisines — the complete guide to Chettinad.
- [Chidambaram Guide: Nataraja Temple & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chidambaram-travel-guide): One of the Pancha Bhoota Stalams and the spiritual home of the cosmic dance — the complete guide to Chidambaram's Nataraja Temple.
- [Coimbatore Travel Guide: Gateway to the Nilgiris](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/coimbatore-travel-guide): A textile city turned home to one of the world's largest bust sculptures, and the most practical launchpad for Ooty and Valparai.
- [Courtallam Falls Guide: Best Time & How to Reach](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/courtallam-travel-guide): Known as the 'Spa of South India' — a cluster of waterfalls with a devoted Aavani bathing season and a temple town built around them, the complete Courtallam guide.
- [Hogenakkal Falls Guide: Boating & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/hogenakkal-travel-guide): Where the Kaveri drops through a rocky gorge, best seen from a traditional round coracle threading the rapids — the complete Hogenakkal guide.
- [Kanchipuram Travel Guide: Temples & Silk Sarees](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kanchipuram-travel-guide): The City of a Thousand Temples and the home of India's finest handwoven silk — the complete Kanchipuram guide.
- [Kanyakumari Travel Guide: Sunrise, Sunset & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kanyakumari-travel-guide): Three seas meet at India's southernmost tip, where sunrise and sunset can both be watched over water from nearly the same shore — the complete Kanyakumari guide.
- [Kodaikanal Travel Guide: Lake, Views & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kodaikanal-travel-guide): A star-shaped lake, ridge-top walks, and a flower that blooms only once every twelve years — the complete guide to the Princess of Hill Stations.
- [Kolli Hills Travel Guide: 70 Hairpin Bends & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kolli-hills-travel-guide): A famously winding ghat road, a quiet waterfall, and one of Tamil Nadu's least-crowded hill ranges — a genuine escape from the state's better-known hill stations.
- [Madurai Travel Guide: Meenakshi Temple & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/madurai-travel-guide): Fourteen painted gopurams rising over one of India's oldest cities — the complete guide to Madurai, the Meenakshi Amman Temple, and the old-town streets around it.
- [Mahabalipuram Travel Guide: Shore Temples & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mahabalipuram-travel-guide): A UNESCO World Heritage cluster of 7th-century Pallava rock-cut monuments on the Bay of Bengal — the complete Mahabalipuram guide.
- [Meghamalai Guide: High Wavy Mountains & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/meghamalai-travel-guide): Tea and cardamom estates folded into a wildlife sanctuary in the Western Ghats — one of Tamil Nadu's most remote, lightly touristed hill ranges.
- [Ooty Travel Guide: Nilgiris, Lakes & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/ooty-travel-guide): A colonial-era hill station, a UNESCO toy train, and tea gardens rolling across the Nilgiris — the complete Ooty guide.
- [Rameswaram Travel Guide: Temple & Dhanushkodi](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rameswaram-travel-guide): India's longest temple corridor, a historic sea bridge, and a cyclone-ruined ghost town at the edge of the map — the complete Rameswaram guide.
- [Thanjavur Travel Guide: Brihadeeswarar Temple](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/thanjavur-travel-guide): An 80-tonne granite capstone hauled to the top of an 11th-century tower — the complete guide to Thanjavur and the Chola dynasty's greatest temple.
- [Tiruvannamalai Guide: Arunachala & Girivalam](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/tiruvannamalai-travel-guide): A fire-element Shiva temple, a hill devotees regard as a living deity, and a 14 km barefoot walk that draws pilgrims and seekers from across India.
- [Valparai Travel Guide: Tea Estates & Wildlife](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/valparai-travel-guide): A tea-plantation plateau in the Western Ghats where elephants and rare lion-tailed macaques share the road with the estates, reached by 40 hairpin bends — the complete Valparai guide.
- [Yelagiri Travel Guide: Lake, Hills & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/yelagiri-travel-guide): A small, quiet hill station with a lake, orchards, and one of Tamil Nadu's best paragliding spots — an easy weekend escape from Chennai or Bangalore.
- [Yercaud Travel Guide: Coffee Hills & Best Time](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/yercaud-travel-guide): A quieter alternative to Ooty and Kodaikanal, ringed by coffee and orange plantations in the Shevaroy Hills — the complete Yercaud guide.

### Andhra Pradesh

- 🗺️ [Andhra Pradesh Travel Guide: Tirupati, Visakhapatnam & Araku Valley](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/andhra-pradesh-travel-guide): From the world's richest temple at Tirumala to Vizag's underrated coastline and the coffee-scented hills of Araku Valley — a complete guide to Andhra Pradesh's pilgrimage sites, beaches, and fiery cuisine.

- [Araku Valley Travel Guide: Coffee Hills & the Train Journey Through 58 Tunnels](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/araku-valley-travel-guide): A coffee-growing tribal valley in the Eastern Ghats, reached by a train ride through 58 tunnels and dozens of bridges — the complete guide to Araku Valley.

- [Borra Caves Travel Guide: Million-Year-Old Limestone Caverns](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/borra-caves-travel-guide): Some of India's largest and oldest limestone caves, with stalactite formations that took over a million years to form — the complete guide to Borra Caves.
- [Gandikota Travel Guide: India's Grand Canyon](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/gandikota-travel-guide): A red sandstone gorge carved by the Pennar River, ringed by a 13th-century fort, that's earned the nickname 'Grand Canyon of India' — the complete guide to Gandikota.
- [Horsley Hills Travel Guide: A Quiet Hill Station in Rayalaseema](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/horsley-hills-travel-guide): A cool, forested hill station between Tirupati and Bangalore that's stayed genuinely low-key despite its convenient location — the complete guide to Horsley Hills.
- [Lambasingi Travel Guide: The Kashmir of Andhra Pradesh](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/lambasingi-travel-guide): A high-altitude village that drops below freezing on winter mornings, earning it the nickname 'Kashmir of Andhra Pradesh' — the complete guide to Lambasingi.
- [Maredumilli Travel Guide: Rainforest Eco-Tourism in the Eastern Ghats](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/maredumilli-travel-guide): A genuinely dense rainforest pocket of the Eastern Ghats, with waterfalls, hot springs, and tribal eco-tourism camps largely undiscovered by mainstream travelers — the complete guide to Maredumilli.
- [Papi Hills Travel Guide: Godavari Gorge Boat Cruise](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/papi-hills-travel-guide): A gorge where the Godavari River narrows between forested hills, best seen from the deck of a slow boat cruise — the complete guide to Papi Hills.
- [Rajahmundry Travel Guide: Godavari Bridges & Papi Hills Gateway](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rajahmundry-travel-guide): A Godavari riverside city with one of Asia's longest road-cum-rail bridges, and the departure point for boat cruises into the Papi Hills gorge — the complete guide to Rajahmundry.
- [Tirupati Travel Guide: Tirumala Temple, Darshan & How to Reach](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/tirupati-travel-guide): The world's most visited and richest pilgrimage temple, atop a hill where millions queue every year for a few seconds before the deity — the complete guide to Tirupati.
- [Vijayawada Travel Guide: Kanaka Durga Temple & Krishna River](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/vijayawada-travel-guide): A hilltop Durga temple overlooking the Krishna River, and a business city that's become one of Andhra Pradesh's most important transit hubs — the complete guide to Vijayawada.
- [Visakhapatnam Travel Guide: Beaches, Submarine Museum & Vizag City Guide](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/visakhapatnam-travel-guide): A port city where a decommissioned submarine sits beached as a museum, and the coastline curves into some of the Bay of Bengal's most underrated beaches — the complete guide to Visakhapatnam.

### Telangana

- 🗺️ [Telangana Travel Guide: Hyderabad, Warangal & Temples](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/telangana-travel-guide): Nizam-era palaces, Kakatiya-era temples, and a Jyotirlinga hidden in tiger country — the complete guide to Telangana, from Charminar's bazaars to a five-day temple-and-nature circuit.

- [Bhadrachalam Travel Guide: Temple & Godavari](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bhadrachalam-travel-guide): A temple built on a devotee's sacrifice, ghats on the sacred Godavari, and an annual celestial wedding that draws crowds from across South India.

- [Golconda Fort Guide: History, Sound Show & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/golconda-fort-travel-guide): A hilltop citadel engineered so a single hand clap could be heard a kilometre away — once the beating heart of the world's diamond trade.
- [Hyderabad Travel Guide: Charminar, Golconda & Food](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/hyderabad-travel-guide): A Qutb Shahi fort, a Nizam-era monument, and a biryani tradition Hyderabadis will argue about for hours — the complete guide to Telangana's capital.
- [Kawal Tiger Reserve: Safari Guide & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kawal-tiger-reserve-travel-guide): Dry deciduous forest, the rare four-horned antelope, and a genuinely offbeat wildlife corridor in northern Telangana — the complete Kawal guide.
- [Kuntala Waterfall Guide: Telangana's Tallest Falls](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kuntala-waterfall-travel-guide): A 45-metre drop through remote Adilabad-district forest — Telangana's tallest waterfall, and one of its most genuinely far-flung destinations.
- [Laknavaram Lake Guide: Bridge, Boating & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/laknavaram-travel-guide): A horseshoe-shaped lake scattered with forested islands and a cantilever bridge that walks you out over the water — Mulugu district's most photographed stop.
- [Medaram Jatara Guide: Sammakka Saralamma Festival](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/medaram-travel-guide): One of the largest tribal gatherings on earth, held once every two years deep in a Telangana forest — the complete guide to Medaram.
- [Nagarjuna Sagar Guide: Dam, Island & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/nagarjuna-sagar-travel-guide): One of the world's largest masonry dams, and an island museum of relocated Buddhist heritage reachable only by boat — the complete Nagarjuna Sagar guide.
- [Srisailam Travel Guide: Jyotirlinga & Nallamala](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/srisailam-travel-guide): A Jyotirlinga and a Shakti Peetha under one roof, reached by a winding forest road through the Nallamala hills above a dramatic Krishna river gorge — the complete Srisailam guide.
- [Vemulawada Temple Guide: Darshan & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/vemulawada-travel-guide): Known locally as the 'Dakshina Kashi' — a Shiva temple sharing its complex with a Vishnu shrine, and one of Telangana's most significant pilgrimage towns.
- [Warangal Travel Guide: Kakatiya Heritage & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/warangal-travel-guide): Star-shaped stone temples, a fort gateway that became Telangana's state emblem, and a UNESCO World Heritage temple nearby — the complete Warangal guide.
- [Yadadri Temple Guide: Darshan, Timings & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/yadadri-travel-guide): An ancient cave shrine rebuilt into one of Telangana's most opulent gold-plated temples — and one of the easiest, most rewarding day trips from Hyderabad.

### Puducherry

- 🗺️ [Puducherry District Travel Guide: All 7 Towns & Attractions](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/puducherry-district-travel-guide): Beyond the French Quarter and Auroville — a full town-by-town guide to Puducherry District, covering Villianur's ancient temple, Ariyankuppam's Arikamedu ruins and Chunnambar boat rides, Bahour's lake, Nettapakkam, and Oulgaret.
- [Karaikal District Travel Guide: Temples, Beach & Cauvery Delta](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/karaikal-district-travel-guide): Tirunallar's famous Saneeswaran Temple and Nala Theertham, Karaikal town's beach, lighthouse and Karaikal Ammaiyar Temple, and the quiet Cauvery delta villages of Neravy, Kottucherry, and Nedungadu.
- [Mahe District Travel Guide: Riverfront, Church & Malabar Coast](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/mahe-district-travel-guide): Mahe town's riverfront walkway, St. Teresa's Shrine, Tagore Park, beach and lighthouse, plus the quiet river villages of Palloor, Pandakkal, Chalakkara, and Parakkal on Kerala's Malabar coast.
- [Puducherry Travel Guide: French Quarter, Auroville & Beaches](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/puducherry-french-quarter-travel-guide): Mustard-yellow colonial villas, a seafront promenade closed to traffic, and the golden Matrimandir at Auroville — the complete guide to India's most European town.
- [Yanam District Travel Guide: Godavari Delta & French Heritage](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/yanam-district-travel-guide): St. Ann's Church, Yanam Ferry Road, the Godavari River, Yanam Tower and Rajiv Gandhi Beach, plus the quiet Godavari delta villages of Mettakur, Kolanka, and Kanakalapeta.

### Lakshadweep

- 🗺️ [Lakshadweep Travel Guide: Permits, Islands & Best Time to Visit](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/lakshadweep-island-travel-guide): Coral atolls barely a kilometre wide, turquoise lagoons, and some of India's clearest diving water — the complete guide to India's least-visited tropical paradise.

- [Kavaratti Island Travel Guide: Lagoon, Diving & Ujra Mosque](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/kavaratti-island-travel-guide): Lakshadweep's capital and most developed inhabited island — Kavaratti Beach and Lagoon, the Marine Aquarium, the driftwood-ceilinged Ujra Mosque, scuba diving, snorkelling, and glass-bottom boat rides.

### Odisha

- 🗺️ [Odisha Travel Guide: Konark, Puri & Chilika Lake](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/odisha-travel-guide): A stone temple carved as a giant chariot, one of Hinduism's holiest shrines, and a lagoon where Irrawaddy dolphins surface between fishing boats — the complete guide to India's most underrated temple state.
- [Bhitarkanika Guide: Mangroves & Crocodiles](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bhitarkanika-travel-guide): India's second-largest mangrove ecosystem, home to some of the country's largest saltwater crocodiles and a globally significant sea-turtle nesting beach.
- [Bhubaneswar Travel Guide: Temple City of India](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bhubaneswar-travel-guide): Over 700 historic temples, ancient rock-cut caves, and a peace pagoda on the site of an ancient war — the complete guide to Odisha's capital city.
- [Chandipur Beach Guide: The Vanishing Sea](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chandipur-travel-guide): A quiet stretch of Odisha coastline where the tide pulls the sea back as much as 5 kilometres, and brings it home again a few hours later.
- [Chilika Lake Guide: Dolphins, Birds & Boating](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/chilika-lake-travel-guide): Asia's largest brackish water lagoon, home to Irrawaddy dolphins and hundreds of thousands of wintering migratory birds — the complete Chilika Lake guide.
- [Cuttack Travel Guide: Silver City & Barabati Fort](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/cuttack-travel-guide): Odisha's former capital, famed for delicate silver filigree craftsmanship, riverside fort ruins, and an annual festival commemorating an ancient seafaring past.
- [Daringbadi Guide: The Kashmir of Odisha](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/daringbadi-travel-guide): Pine forests, coffee plantations, and winter frost in a state almost entirely defined by its coastline — the complete guide to Odisha's most unexpected hill station.
- [Deomali Trek Guide: Odisha's Highest Peak](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/deomali-travel-guide): A quiet, forested climb to Odisha's highest point, through tribal villages and Eastern Ghats woodland — far from any crowded trekking circuit.
- [Jeypore Travel Guide: Tribal Heritage & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/jeypore-travel-guide): A former princely seat, a scenic waterfall, and the practical gateway to southern Odisha's tribal heartland — the complete Jeypore guide.
- [Konark Sun Temple Guide: History & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/konark-travel-guide): A 13th-century temple carved as a colossal stone chariot for the Sun God, with 24 wheels and seven horses — the complete guide to Konark.
- [Koraput Travel Guide: Tribal Culture & Coffee](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/koraput-travel-guide): Coffee plantations climbing the Eastern Ghats and weekly markets where some of India's most distinct tribal communities gather — the complete Koraput guide.
- [Puri Travel Guide: Jagannath Temple & Beach](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/puri-travel-guide): One of Hinduism's four holiest pilgrimage sites, a chariot festival watched by millions, and a laid-back golden-sand beach — the complete guide to Puri.
- [Rourkela Travel Guide: Steel City & Waterfalls](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rourkela-travel-guide): India's first integrated steel plant, a genuine hockey heritage, and one of Odisha's most dramatic waterfalls just beyond the city limits.
- [Sambalpur Guide: Hirakud Dam & Sarees](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sambalpur-travel-guide): One of the world's longest earthen dams, and a city where the looms have been running for centuries — the complete guide to Sambalpur.
- [Satkosia Gorge Guide: Tiger Reserve & Safari](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/satkosia-travel-guide): A dramatic gorge carved by the Mahanadi river through the Eastern Ghats, explored by boat rather than jeep — one of Odisha's quietest, most scenic reserves.
- [Similipal Tiger Reserve: Safari Guide & Tips](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/similipal-travel-guide): One of India's largest tiger reserves, home to the rare melanistic black tiger, dense sal forests, and two of the country's most dramatic waterfalls.

### Bihar

- 🗺️ [Bihar Travel Guide: Bodh Gaya, Nalanda & Patna](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bihar-travel-guide): The place where Buddha attained enlightenment, the ruins of one of the world's oldest universities, and the ancient heartland of the Magadha empire — a complete guide to Bihar's temples, ruins, and history for travelers.
- [Barabar Caves Travel Guide: India's Oldest Rock-Cut Caves](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/barabar-caves-travel-guide): Polished granite caves carved under Emperor Ashoka nearly 2,300 years ago, believed to have inspired the Marabar Caves in A Passage to India — the complete guide to Barabar Caves.
- [Bodh Gaya Travel Guide: Mahabodhi Temple & Buddha's Enlightenment Site](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/bodh-gaya-travel-guide): The exact spot where Buddha is believed to have attained enlightenment under a descendant of the original Bodhi Tree — the complete guide to Bodh Gaya.
- [Gaya Travel Guide: Vishnupad Temple & Pitru Paksha Pilgrimage](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/gaya-travel-guide): A temple town where Hindus perform ancestral rites believed to liberate departed souls, drawing pilgrims from across India every Pitru Paksha — the complete guide to Gaya.
- [Madhubani Travel Guide: The Town Behind India's Famous Folk Art](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/madhubani-travel-guide): The district that gave its name to a distinctive folk-painting style, still practiced by generations of local women artists — the complete guide to Madhubani.
- [Nalanda Travel Guide: Ruins of the World's Oldest University](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/nalanda-travel-guide): The excavated remains of a residential university that once housed thousands of monks and scholars from across Asia, over a thousand years before Oxford existed — the complete guide to Nalanda.
- [Patna Travel Guide: Golghar, Patna Sahib & Bihar's Capital](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/patna-travel-guide): A riverside capital city with a colonial-era granary shaped like a beehive, and one of Sikhism's holiest gurdwaras — the complete guide to Patna.
- [Pawapuri Travel Guide: Where Mahavira Attained Nirvana](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/pawapuri-travel-guide): A lotus-covered temple tank marking the spot where Lord Mahavira, the last Jain Tirthankara, is believed to have attained nirvana — the complete guide to Pawapuri.
- [Rajgir Travel Guide: Hot Springs, Ropeway & Buddhist Heritage](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/rajgir-travel-guide): A hill-ringed town where Buddha spent years teaching, with natural hot springs, an ancient ropeway, and one of the world's oldest surviving jail sites — the complete guide to Rajgir.
- [Sasaram Travel Guide: Sher Shah Suri's Tomb & Grand Trunk Road History](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/sasaram-travel-guide): A monumental tomb rising from an artificial lake, built for the emperor who gave India the Grand Trunk Road and the rupee — the complete guide to Sasaram.
- [Vaishali Travel Guide: The World's First Republic & Buddha's Last Sermon](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/vaishali-travel-guide): A city often cited as the site of the world's earliest republic, where Buddha delivered his final sermon before his death — the complete guide to Vaishali.
- [Valmiki Nagar Travel Guide: Tiger Reserve & Himalayan Foothills](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/valmiki-nagar-travel-guide): Bihar's only tiger reserve, tucked into the Himalayan foothills where the Gandak River enters India from Nepal — the complete guide to Valmiki Nagar.
- [Vikramshila Travel Guide: The Other Great Ancient Buddhist University](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/vikramshila-travel-guide): A lesser-known counterpart to Nalanda, founded by a Pala king specifically to train Tantric Buddhist scholars — the complete guide to Vikramshila.

## Central India

### Madhya Pradesh

- [Khajuraho Temples Travel Guide: History, Timings & Best Time to Visit](https://club.kudozz.in/blog/khajuraho-travel-guide): UNESCO-listed temples covered in some of the most intricate stone carving in India, built by the Chandela dynasty over a thousand years ago — the complete guide to Khajuraho.
